title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
summary: Foundational AWS Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) study workspace covering Cloud Concepts, Security & Compliance, Cloud Technology & Services, and Billing, Pricing & Support.

domains.title: Cloud Concepts
domains.description: Benefits of the AWS Cloud, Well-Architected Framework pillars, cloud adoption strategies (AWS CAF), and cloud economics.

domains.title: Security and Compliance
domains.description: AWS Shared Responsibility Model, IAM least-privilege access, encryption, CloudTrail/GuardDuty/Inspector/Shield/WAF, and compliance resources.

domains.title: Cloud Technology and Services
domains.description: Compute (EC2, Lambda, ECS/EKS), storage (S3, EBS, EFS), databases (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB), networking (VPC, Route 53, CloudFront), and AI/ML.

domains.title: Billing, Pricing, and Support
domains.description: EC2 purchasing options, AWS Organizations consolidated billing, Budgets, Cost Explorer, Pricing Calculator, and AWS Support tiers.
